sentences.text:
Appe
 Through: Mr.Shadab Khan, Advocate.
 versus
 Balram Sarkar & Anr. 
 Through: None.
 Coram:
HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE DHARMESH SHARMA  ORDER % 14.05.2024 1.
Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
2. The application shall stand disposed of.

The appellant is preferring this appeal under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 assailing the impugned judgment - cum - award dated 24.01.2024 passed by the learned Presiding Officer,
MACT, East, Karkardooma Court, Delhi.
4.
No one is present on behalf of the respondent despite sending advance notice.
5. The present matter arises out of the same accident which is in question in MAC.APP. 253/2024 listed today.

6. In brief, it is urged by learned counsel for the appellant that respondent No.1 was a pillion rider on the subject motorcycle that hit the stationary bus from behind and that the respondent No.1 was not wearing a helmet.
This is a digitally signed order.

sentences.text: The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 16/05/2024 at 00:08:29 7.
Insofar as the findings rendered by the learned Tribunal on the issue of finding the driver of the offending bus i.e. Rustam Singh guilty of negligence, the same is unassailable.

However, there is merit in the plea raised by learned counsel for the appellant that the respondent No.1/ injured pillion was not wearing a helmet at the time of the accident and he was also guilty of contributory negligence.
8.
Let notice be issued to the respondents by all permissible mode returnable on 30.09.2024.

9. The operation of the impugned judgment - cum - award dated 24.01.2024 shall remain stayed,
subject to the appellant depositing the entire amount of the compensation with accrued interest with the learned Tribunal within four weeks from today.
On such deposit 75% of the amount of compensation with interest be released to the claimants without prejudice in terms of the directions passed by the learned Tribunal.
10. Let digitised TCR be summoned.

DHARMESH SHARMA, J.
MAY 14, 2024 VLD
